scope: Entire project including Git/control/worktrees/assets/all build targets, entire named inference volume including installed research environments and dependency/model caches, shared Cargo/Rustup/uv caches and project external control state. Conservative project/toolchain inclusion; unrelated host/user data and Codex conversation logs excluded.
method: One GNU du invocation. Allocated st_blocks bytes, hardlinked device/inodes counted once across all arguments, no symlink following; separate mounts explicitly named. Reflink/shared extents are not deduplicated. Observation is not an atomic filesystem snapshot. No payload read or deletion.
reservations: Administrative forecast is separate from current stored bytes; none added to this measurement.
funding: Existing Root cleanup/admin component 268435456B; no new allocation.
coverage: All named legacy cap-covered roots and current research-paths.json destinations are inside declared measured roots. Project and inference roots conservatively include currently stored obsolete/generated/shared bytes.
necessary_data_note: This is current total allocated research-scope storage including code/build/dependencies/obsolete files, not an attribution of uniquely necessary scientific data.
